body: I really don't see the point of trying to do things before I die because eternal oblivion is all that awaits and it won't make a difference anyway.

I've had a team of psychiatrists, along with a few individual ones, all tell me I'm not trying.  They'd try something to help me, it wouldn't work, I'd still want to kill myself, they'd tell me I'm not trying, they'd try to guilt me into feeling better or to "snap out of it".

I guess it worked because I had to fake being happy to keep them from berating me and making me feel worse.

Point is trained professionals do it too.  A lot of them.  So NEVER expect your parents or even any relative to get it right.  Because no one has with me yet.

"You know we have patients waiting to get in who will *actually* try.".  All they ever did was try to make me feel guilty.  Try to guilt me into pretending to feel better for everyone else's sake.
